name: top_finite_monotone_iterate_bot_fixed
statement: {α : Type*} [PartialOrder α] [OrderBot α] [Finite α] (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f) : ∃ n : ℕ, f (f^[n] ⊥) = f^[n] ⊥
closed: ∀ {α : Type*} [PartialOrder α] [OrderBot α] [Finite α] (f : α → α) (hf : Monotone f), ∃ n : ℕ, f (f^[n] ⊥) = f^[n] ⊥
informal: On a finite poset with bottom, iterating a monotone map from ⊥ reaches a fixed point — n ↦ f^[n] ⊥ is monotone; if never stationary it would be strictly monotone hence injective ℕ → α, contradicting finiteness.
type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : PartialOrder α] [inst_1 : OrderBot α] [Finite α] (f : α → α), Monotone f → ∃ n, f (f^[n] ⊥) = f^[n] ⊥
